WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) -
            SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
            SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct);

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
      AND status = 'A'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id
      AND t.date = (SELECT MAX(t2.date)
                    FROM trans t2
                    WHERE t2.account_id = target.account_id
                      AND t2.date <= '1993-03-22')
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t, target
    WHERE t.account_id = target.account_id
      AND t.date = (SELECT MAX(t2.date)
                    FROM trans t2
                    WHERE t2.account_id = target.account_id
                      AND t2.date <= '1998-12-27')
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (bal_end.balance - bal_start.balance) * 100.0 / bal_start.balance AS increase_rate
FROM bal_start, bal_end;

JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT T1.superhero_name 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id 
WHERE T2.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue' AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(alignment.id) * 100.0
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT SUM(colour.id = 7) - SUM(colour.id = 1)
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 0 OR superhero.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM superhero 
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' 
  AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT superhero.superhero_name
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY superhero.superhero_name ASC;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY T1.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(T1.height_cm)
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id
JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1.publisher_id = T3.id
WHERE T2.race <> 'Human'
  AND T3.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM hero_attribute 
JOIN attribute ON hero_attribute.attribute_id = attribute.id 
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed' 
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT SUM(publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS difference
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT T1.attribute_name
FROM attribute AS T1
JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.attribute_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY T2.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE height_cm = (SELECT MAX(height_cm) FROM superhero);
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
WHERE T1.weight_kg < 100 AND T2.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT T1.id 
FROM superhero AS T1 
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id 
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id 
WHERE T3.power_name = 'Intelligence'

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT T3.power_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T1.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) FROM superhero) * 0.8

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT P.SEX, P.Birthday, E.`Examination Date`, E.Symptoms
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.ID = '163109';

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH > '500';

SELECT Patient.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L.`T-CHO` >= '250';

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.TP < '6.0' OR T2.TP > '8.5' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T1.`aCL IgG`) 
FROM Examination AS T1 
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Admission = '+' 
  AND (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday)) >= '50';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', `First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID 
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = '1' 
  AND strftime('%Y', Examination.`Examination Date`) = '1997' 
  AND Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(T3.Birthday)
    FROM Patient AS T3
    WHERE T3.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Examination)
)
AND T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT T2.Date, SUBSTR(T1.`First Date`, 1, 4) - SUBSTR(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS Age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT Patient.ID
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
    GROUP BY Patient.ID
    HAVING CAST(SUBSTR(MIN(Examination.`Examination Date`), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) 
         - CAST(SUBSTR(Patient.`First Date`, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'
  AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID 
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= '2.0'

SELECT Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS age, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID
ORDER BY T3.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND "Examination Date" = '1996-12-02';
SELECT "T-CHO" < 250 FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464 AND DATETIME(Date) = '1995-09-04';
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY "First Date" ASC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993/11/12';
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'
SELECT strftime('%Y', T1.Date) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T2 JOIN Laboratory AS T1 ON T2.ID = T1.ID WHERE T1.UA = '8.4' AND T1.Date = '1991-10-21'
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE "First Date" = '1991-06-13' AND Diagnosis = 'SJS') AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1995';

SELECT P."Diagnosis"
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID = (
    SELECT E.ID
    FROM Examination E
    WHERE E."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27'
      AND E."Diagnosis" = 'SLE'
);

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959/03/01'
  AND e."Examination Date" = '1993/09/27';

SELECT (
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-11%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)
    -
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-12%' THEN l.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)
) AS decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-02-18';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet' AND T1.Description >= '1997-01-01' AND T1.Description < '1998-01-01';
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE GPT > 30 AND ALB < 4 AND Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31';
SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND Admission = '+'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + (AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`)) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.`T-BIL` < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'F' 
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'PSS' AND T3.CRP > 2 AND T3.CRE = 1 AND T3.LDH = 123
SELECT AVG(L.ALB) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.PLT > 400 AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT MAX(T1.Symptoms) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5

SELECT CAST(JULIANDAY(`Examination Date`) - JULIANDAY(`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS `Days Until Evaluation`
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ID = 57266
  AND ((Laboratory.UA > 8.0 AND Patient.SEX = 'M')
       OR (Laboratory.UA > 6.5 AND Patient.SEX = 'F'));
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 48473 AND GOT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) = '1994'
  AND Laboratory.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GPT > 60
ORDER BY T1.Birthday;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500;

SELECT P.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(P.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT t1.ID, t2.ALP < 300
FROM Patient AS t1
JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID
WHERE t1.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TP < 6.0;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.TP - 8.5
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.TP > 8.5;

SELECT Patient.*
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT P.ID,
       CASE
           WHEN L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
           ELSE 'No'
       END AS "Albumin Within Normal Range"
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.UA > 6.5 THEN T1.ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5))
  AND T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Result
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory)
);

SELECT SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 
GROUP BY SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.TG >= 200
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' 
  AND T1.SEX = 'M' 
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GLU >= 180 AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GLU < 180
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991';

SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday
FROM Patient
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE WBC <= 3.5 OR WBC >= 9.0
)
ORDER BY SEX, Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50
  AND (l.RBC <= 3.5 OR l.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10 AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID, strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2;
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) = '1984'
  AND strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) < 50
  AND Laboratory.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(l.PT >= 14 AND p.SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / SUM(l.PT >= 14) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992' AND T2.PT < 14

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination 
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Examination.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND Laboratory.APTT < 45;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.APTT > 45 AND T2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (CAST(Laboratory.FG AS REAL) < 150 OR CAST(Laboratory.FG AS REAL) > 450);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."U-PRO" > 0 AND T2."U-PRO" < 30
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1

WITH CustomerYearConsumption AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, y.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS LowestConsumption
    FROM CustomerYearConsumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestCustomers AS (
    SELECT cyc.Segment,
           SUM(cyc.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumptionPerYear,
           COUNT(cyc.CustomerID) AS NumLowestCustomers
    FROM CustomerYearConsumption cyc
    JOIN MinConsumption mc
      ON cyc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cyc.TotalConsumption = mc.LowestConsumption
    GROUP BY cyc.Segment
),
SegmentAnnualAverage AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumptionPerYear * 1.0 / NumLowestCustomers AS AnnualAverage
    FROM LowestCustomers
),
Pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN AnnualAverage END) AS SME_Avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN AnnualAverage END) AS LAM_Avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN AnnualAverage END) AS KAM_Avg
    FROM SegmentAnnualAverage
)
SELECT
    SME_Avg - LAM_Avg AS Difference_SME_LAM,
    LAM_Avg - KAM_Avg AS Difference_LAM_KAM,
    KAM_Avg - SME_Avg AS Difference_KAM_SME
FROM Pivoted

JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
GROUP BY P.player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(PA.crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' AND M.home_team_goal - M.away_team_goal < 0
GROUP BY T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(pa.penalties) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND M.season = '2009/2010'
  AND M.away_team_goal - M.home_team_goal > 0
GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T.team_long_name, TA.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
ORDER BY TA.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name,
       (strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', P.birthday)) AS present_age
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', PA.date) AS INTEGER) >= 2013
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', PA.date) AS INTEGER) <= 2015;

SELECT L.name, COUNT(M.league_id) AS num_matches
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY num_matches DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(T1.height) / COUNT(T1.id) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.birthday >= '1990-01-01 00:00:00' AND T1.birthday < '1996-01-01 00:00:00'

SELECT T1.player_api_id
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE substr(T2.date, 1, 4) = '2010'
  AND T2.overall_rating > (SELECT AVG(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
  AND T2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '2010')
SELECT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
      SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      JOIN Team AS T2 ON T2.team_api_id = TA2.team_api_id
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
        AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT SUM(T1.preferred_foot = 'left') * 100.0 / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_foot
FROM Player AS T2
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T2.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992;

SELECT L.name AS league_name, SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) AS total_goals
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
GROUP BY L.id, L.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT SUM(Player_Attributes.long_shots) / COUNT(Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
WHERE Player.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE P.height > 180
GROUP BY P.player_api_id, P.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(PA.heading_accuracy) / COUNT(PA.player_fifa_api_id) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND TA.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE TA2.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
        AND TA2.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
        AND TA2.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'

WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'

FROM Player P1
JOIN Player_Attributes A1 ON P1.player_api_id = A1.player_api_id
JOIN Player P2 ON P2.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery'
JOIN Player_Attributes A2 ON P2.player_api_id = A2.player_api_id
WHERE P1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
  AND A1.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
  AND A2.date LIKE '2013-07-12%';

FROM Player p

SELECT T1.player_api_id FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T1.weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime') - datetime(birthday) > 34

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_1
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_2
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_4
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_5
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_6
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_7
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_8
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_9
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_10
   OR p.player_api_id = m.home_player_11
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon';

SELECT SUM(m.away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN Player p1
  ON (m.away_player_1 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_2 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_3 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_4 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_5 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_6 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_7 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_8 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_9 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_10 = p1.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_11 = p1.player_api_id)
JOIN Player p2
  ON (m.away_player_1 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_2 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_3 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_4 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_5 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_6 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_7 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_8 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_9 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_10 = p2.player_api_id
   OR m.away_player_11 = p2.player_api_id)
WHERE p1.player_name = 'Daan Smith'
  AND p2.player_name = 'Filipe Ferreira';

SELECT SUM(t.home_team_goal)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.home_team_goal
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
                             m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
                             m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11)
    WHERE (julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(p.birthday))) / 365.25 < 31
) t;
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT DISTINCT Player.player_name

WHERE T2.finishing = 1
GROUP BY T1.player_name
ORDER BY MAX(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime') - datetime(T1.birthday)) DESC

FROM Match AS M
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
JOIN Player AS P ON P.player_api_id IN (

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0
   / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');
